model: Foldable Bike Cargo Trailer with 16" Wheels
description:
Large Capacity & Safety Design--This bicycle trailer features a lightweight yet sturdy metal frame, providing ample storage space. It is equipped with 2 red and 4 yellow reflectors to enhance visibility during nighttime rides, ensuring your safety.

Detachable Design--The front, rear, and side walls can be easily detached, allowing for a flatbed trailer configuration and accommodating larger items.

Smooth and Safe Ride-- The trailer is equipped with 16" inflatable wheels that provide increased traction and a smooth rolling experience. Each wheel has two yellow reflectors for added safety. The user-friendly handlebar design allows for easy towing and loading of items.

Foldable Support Arm-- The trailer features a foldable support arm at the front, allowing you to quickly and securely park the trailer. Simply adjust the support arm by inserting or removing the pins, making it easy to maneuver or park the trailer.

Versatile Design-- Ideal for daily commuting or long-distance travel, this trailer is a versatile choice. It can be used for shopping, transporting goods, and other errands. You can even use it to take your pets along for a ride.
